description: Procurement planning parameters for one company.

fields.description: Completed months used for the average sales.
fields.label: Analysis Months

fields.description: How often purchasing is reviewed. Added to the lead time to give the planning horizon.
fields.label: Review Period Days

fields.description: A month is left out of the average when the item was out of stock on at least this share of its days.
fields.label: Stock-out Month Threshold

fields.description: Purchase Orders late by up to this many days still count as supply. Later ones are shown as overdue and not counted. Shipped quantities always count at their arrival date.
fields.label: Late PO Tolerance Days

fields.description: Sales Order lines with a Purchase Order raised against them, and those Purchase Order lines, are left out of stock planning.
fields.label: Exclude Back-to-Back Orders

fields.description: Used only when neither the Item nor a Lead Time Profile gives a lead time. 0 means no default: such items are flagged.
fields.label: Default Lead Time Days

fields.description: Purchase Receipts in this window are used to derive lead times.
fields.label: Lead Time History Months

fields.description: A supplier or supplier + brand needs at least this many received Purchase Orders to get a derived lead time.
fields.label: Minimum Purchase Orders per Lead Time

fields.description: When an item has no supplier maintained, the supplier of its latest Purchase Order in this window is used.
fields.label: Supplier History Months

fields.description: Target warehouse for Material Requests created from the planning screen.
fields.label: Default Purchase Warehouse

name: Procurement Planning Settings
